name: ultrawatch
description: Watch YouTube for the agent: turn a video, a playlist or a channel into timestamped, chaptered transcripts and on-screen frames, answer questions without re-reading the video, and check that every claim cites a [V# mm:ss] stamp that exists. Local and keyless: yt-dlp, the video's own subtitles, local whisper. A skills.sh agent skill.

scripts.check:build: tsup && webindex skill copy && git diff --exit-code -- scripts/ultrawatch.mjs skills/ultrawatch/scripts/ultrawatch.mjs && webindex skill check && webindex skill bundle && webindex skill vendor --check
scripts.engine:gate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:build && pnpm run eval

author: maxgfr
